test_definition.fixture: Isolated 2 m straight Y-directed cantilever; only physical root translations and rotations are fixed.
test_definition.reference_scope: Thin-wall torsion and Euler-Bernoulli bending scales only; the principal check is native b/c/d equivalent-load response.
test_definition.previous_probe_gap: The earlier arm force in global Z generated Mx and did not test My torsion of a beam aligned with global Y.
test_definition.native_moment_scope: Direct native My is applied using beam degree of freedom 5; rotation readout nodes carry no mass, force, spring or support.
test_definition.comparison_note: Compare native tip response and theta_y with direct Fx plus My; relative point motion is checked against the full Rodrigues rotation, retaining any bending rotation.
